verdict.rationale: Cline's own CLI docs show an image file passed into a prompt to drive code changes ("fix the layout issue shown in @./screenshot.png"), so image input feeding code generation is a documented capability. Nothing shows it generating a whole working app from a design, and sketch or PDF input is never mentioned. Missing for 10: documented app generation from a design, sketch input, PDF input, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can generate a working app from a sketch, image, or PDF design
